item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "f3f9a1d0ed3ccc811a0270e0099083c9b9258aa6d3bcdca151d40ca861a28cfb",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef002 specialized to vectors indexed by Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side of the equivalence expands to exactly the condition on the right side.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For a finite coordinate type, every real a, b, t satisfies both interval integrability of x ↦ q(x,t) and differentiability at t of τ ↦ ∫ₐᵇ q(x,τ) dx with derivative flux(q(a,t)) − flux(q(b,t)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the entire left-hand predicate; it imposes the same universally quantified conjunction as the right-hand side.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on the real-valued function space over any index type is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity needed to express vector-valued derivatives; it is not a continuity assumption on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides underlying additive structure for scalar-action instances without changing operations or adding hypotheses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes real multiplication as the scalar action used in the continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction requiring both constituent propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires integrability and the specified derivative simultaneously for each interval and time.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Obtains a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field, preserving its normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar-field structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the monoid action underlying a distributive scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the coordinate scalar action in the construction of continuous vector scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real semiring operations to module and scalar-action constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the semifield operations and laws of a field while forgetting the additional additive-group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms part of the scalar structure on the reals without restricting q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "States and flux values have m real coordinates; when m = 0, there are no coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n using the finite list of indices below n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies finiteness needed for the finite product norm and vector integration structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation from a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here subtracts the flux at the second endpoint from the flux at the first endpoint in the same vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the full neighborhood of that point and fixing the base point in the derivative filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the ordinary two-sided real derivative of the vector-valued interval integral at each t, equal to the endpoint flux difference.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each proposition implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts equivalence of the named predicate and its expanded definition, not that either holds for every q and flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector-space structure from an inner-product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real-coordinate normed-space structure used to construct the vector space for integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "The function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Imposes integrability on the interval between the endpoints regardless of their order; equal endpoints give empty integration domains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology implies joint continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real scalar multiplication as a structural instance, not a regularity condition on the input functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has continuous addition and multiplication as required of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar multiplication continuity instance on the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring, acting on itself, has the corresponding module topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the topology of the real scalar ring to the continuity instance required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure from a measure-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measure in all integrability and integral expressions to the measure supplied by Real.measureSpace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the standard real scalar action in the derivative's vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication structure from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar semigroup structure used by scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid structure from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative monoid used in scalar actions, without requiring scalars to be nonzero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action when assembling its continuity structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m ranges over all nonnegative integers without a positivity assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement from a nonunital commutative ring while retaining its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker real ring structure for topological instances; it does not change the arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity requirement from a nonunital nonassociative commutative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the underlying real ring structure used by the topological-ring instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid of a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for the coordinate module constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital commutative ring operations and laws from a normed version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real ring structure to the topology construction without altering operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real seminormed additive group used for vector-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed additive data underlying the real-coordinate vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative associativity from a nonunital semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of ordinary real additive structure for the module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field structure from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the real field and norm used in differentiation and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real-coordinate normed additive group used by interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with the associated extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the vector norm available to the integrability predicate; it does not change the vector domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains normed commutative ring operations while forgetting the designated multiplicative identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance with the same norm and arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real seminormed structures for the vector-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real field arithmetic to scalar structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed field as a normed commutative ring with the same norm, metric, and ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real scalar field to its ring topology and normed additive structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the linear structure required for the vector-valued derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Makes a function space into a module using pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies Fin m → Real with an m-coordinate real vector space for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a product of additive commutative groups its pointwise additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, zero, and negation in the derivative are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines subtraction of functions pointwise: (f − g)(i) = f(i) − g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The ith derivative coordinate is flux(q(x₁,t))(i) − flux(q(x₂,t))(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive commutative groups with its product normed additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite-dimensional vector norm and metric needed for the interval integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive groups with its product normed additive group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the vector norm underlying interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "A finite product of normed spaces is a normed space with pointwise module operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows real vector-valued integration of q using the finite-coordinate product structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology induced by all coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector limits and derivatives use the ordinary finite product topology on the real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the real absolute-difference metric into the topology used for derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Makes a real-like or complex-like field a real inner-product space with its compatible real normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "For Real, supplies its usual one-dimensional real normed-space structure; no complex state coordinates are introduced.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Space, time, coordinates, and scalars are real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has norms lying between any two strictly ordered positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial real norm required for the derivative; it imposes no bound on the values of q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real addition in the scalar topology construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides coordinatewise vector additive-group operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure of real addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra and its scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real numbers as an RCLike field, with real-part map the identity, imaginary-part map zero, and distinguished imaginary element zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real normed-space and inner-product infrastructure without adding any imaginary component.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides underlying real additive and multiplicative structures used by module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction defined as addition of the negative: a − b = a + (−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the coordinate flux difference with the first endpoint positive and the second endpoint negative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The installed measure-space structure on Real; the displayed body delegates its selection to inferInstance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes one measure for all spatial integrals. The supplied body does not expose that measure's construction or normalization.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group equipped with its real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate norm and metric for vector integration and integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its compatible real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible real ring and norm structures throughout the explicit type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its compatible real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar normed field for the real derivative and vector integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric with distance d(x,y) = |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Time neighborhoods and coordinate topologies use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The real semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the semiring used when obtaining continuity of real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations used in the additive and scalar structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the division-semiring operations and laws of a semifield while forgetting multiplicative commutativity as a requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar structure without imposing nonzero restrictions on individual scalars or states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the real coordinate scalar multiplication used in the vector continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations, seminorm, and pseudometric while forgetting the designated multiplicative identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the underlying seminormed real additive structure used in normed-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a seminormed commutative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real pseudometric with unchanged operations and norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric space from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real topology used for continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication, its identity, and its absorbing zero from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the multiplicative real scalar structure for module actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the designated multiplicative identity structure of a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of real addition for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real topology and hence the product topology of the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Pointwise scalar multiplication on a product is jointly continuous whenever it is jointly continuous on every coordinate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous scalar multiplication on Fin m → Real required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary subtraction operation as heterogeneous subtraction with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed subtraction to ordinary coordinatewise vector subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real numbers form a topological ring: their ring operations are continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Justifies structural continuity of real scalar multiplication; it says nothing about continuity of q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The oriented vector integral from a to b is the integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], both with the specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the orientation of the spatial integral, reverses its sign when endpoints are exchanged, and makes it zero for equal endpoints.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A structure giving a finite exhaustive enumeration of the elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "LocalDef002 permits any finite coordinate type; the target specializes it to Fin m. Finiteness does not require nonemptiness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the scalar action map (c,v) ↦ c • v.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural property of the real vector space used for derivatives, not a hypothesis about either input function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication of functions pointwise: (c • f)(i) = c • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative linearization and vector scalar multiplication act independently on each real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m, including m = 0.",
      "For every function q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ^m, represented as q(x,t)(i) with i ∈ Fin m; the first real argument is the spatial integration variable and the second is the differentiation variable.",
      "For every function flux : ℝ^m → ℝ^m; it takes the whole state vector and may couple its coordinates.",
      "Within both equivalent conditions, for every x₁, x₂, t ∈ ℝ, with no ordering restriction on x₁ and x₂.",
      "The variable x is bound by the spatial integral, and τ is the argument of the function differentiated at t. Both endpoints remain fixed during differentiation.",
      "There are no existentially quantified witnesses."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no additional hypotheses on m, q, or flux beyond their types. The displayed integrability and derivative requirements are inside the equivalent predicates."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "LocalDef001(q,flux) holds if and only if, for every real x₁, x₂, t, the spatial function x ↦ q(x,t) is integrable on both (x₁,x₂] and (x₂,x₁] with respect to μ = Real.measureSpace.volume, and the vector-valued function τ ↦ ∫ from x₁ to x₂ q(x,τ) dμ(x) has derivative flux(q(x₁,t)) − flux(q(x₂,t)) at t.",
      "After expanding LocalDef001 and LocalDef002, the equivalence has identical mathematical conditions on its two sides."
    ],
